items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile Press Conference: AI Key Notes 2026/11/12
paras:
一、財務表現：前三季EPS 4.26元，年增22% 

第三季財務表現
合併營收503.7億元，年增9%。
合併營業利益58.9億元，年增15%。
EBITDA 113.1億元。
稅後淨利42.6億元，年增18%。
EPS 1.40元，年增18%。
前三季財務表現
合併營收1,495.8億元。
合併營業利益179.4億元，年增16%。
稅後淨利129.5億元，年增23%。
EPS 4.26元，年增22%，每股獲利居電信業之冠。
自由現金流量184.8億元，年增24%。
整體財務亮點
營收、營業利益及稅後淨利均維持成長，獲利成長幅度高於營收。
三大成長引擎持續發揮綜效，帶動營運槓桿效益。
前三季EPS達4.26元，年增22%，領先電信同業。

二、三大事業：企業服務成長最強，電信本業穩健 

1. Telco 電信本業
行動服務營收170.5億元，年增3%，創歷史新高。
5G營收占比達7成。
智慧型手機月租用戶ARPU達697元，年增3%。
月租用戶退租率降至0.48%，再創歷史新低。
智慧型手機5G滲透率提升至46%。
4G用戶續約升轉5G後，月租費平均提升47%。
家戶用戶事業收入年增14%。
寬頻業務營收年增5%。
2. Telco+ 企業電信事業：第三季營收年增34%
AIDC等資料中心業務營收年增1.4倍
企業資通訊服務營收年增2.84倍
資安服務營收年增53%
IoT物聯網服務營收年增23%
行動廣告聯播網營收(含商務簡訊與行動廣告)則年增10%。
中小企業、餐飲及零售店家打造的一站式智慧解決方案「OP 開店包」用戶數則年增37%。
3. Telco+Tech 新科技電信事業：排除momo營收年增14%
第三季營收若排除momo，年增14%，主要成長來源包括：
品牌電商： 營收年增86%。
OTT服務與內容投資： 營收年增26%。
其他業務： 電信帳單代收代付服務「大哥付隨帳收」、遊戲發行及MyVideo等。
momo電商營運
第三季電商交易總額（GMV）年增11%。
有購會員數年增5%。
總營收262.97億元，年增7%，獲利能力維持穩健。
mo店+商品交易總額（GMV）達雙位數年增長，商品數超過430萬件。
momo聯播網廣告收入呈雙位數年增長。

三、精誠資訊：完成公開收購，持股提高至61.02% 

收購交易結果
台灣大旗下台信電訊公開收購精誠資訊普通股案已完成。
台信電訊收購精誠已發行股份49.16%。
加計台灣大原持有的11.86%，交易完成後總持股達61.02%。
交易對價包含現金約124億元，以及台灣大普通股約1.124億股。
財務影響
依擬制性資產負債表試算，收購後台灣大合併總資產將增加至3,000億元。
以2026年前三季精誠獲利為基礎，在未考量相關利息支出下進行擬制試算：精誠對台灣大的淨利貢獻，將由收購前約2.34億元提升至12.26億元，獲利貢獻約為收購前的5.2倍。
本次投資案預期立即為EPS帶來增益。
淨財務槓桿僅微幅上升，台灣大仍保有高度財務彈性。

items.title: 博智越南新廠明年進入量產 有機會將伺服器板打入太空新專案
items.title_en: Bozhi Vietnam New Plant Enters Mass Production Next Year, Potential to Bring Server Boards into New Space Projects
paras: PCB廠博智(8155-TW)的越南新生產線將在明(2027)年進入量產，博智今(12)日召開法人說明會並指出，在產品應用方面，博智目前來自AI伺服器應用板仍是主要博智成長動能；同時，博智預期將伺服器板打入太空的新專案未來具參與機會。太空資料中心方面等同地上預期設計規格差異不大，但是不同平台仍有客製化的需求。
PCB廠博智1-9月營收48.11億元，稅後純益6.81億元，每股純益達11.15元公司表示，目前伺服器產品應用PCB仍為營收主力，營收占比約82%，主要是其他產品應用增加。
博智在越南投資設廠明年進入量產，爲公司與日本 Meiko (名幸電子)合資，且名幸電子本身就是 SpaceX 供應鏈，也因此博智越南廠進一步有機會再切入AI伺服器的天上版。
paras_en: PCB manufacturer Bozhi (8155-TW) says its new production line in Vietnam will enter mass production next year (2027). Bozhi held an investor briefing today (the 12th) and noted that in terms of product applications, its AI server application boards remain the main growth driver; at the same time, Bozhi expects opportunities to participate in new space projects that will incorporate server boards. For space data centers, the design specifications are not much different from ground‑based ones, but different platforms still require customization.

Bozhi reported revenue of NT$4.811 billion and net profit after tax of NT$681 million for January‑September, with earnings per share of NT$11.15. The company said server‑application PCBs remain the main revenue source, accounting for about 82% of sales, while other product applications are increasing.

Bozhi’s investment in a plant in Vietnam, which will start mass production next year, is a joint venture with Japan’s Meiko (Meiko Electronics). Meiko is itself part of the SpaceX supply chain, giving Bozhi’s Vietnam factory further chances to tap into the “sky‑version” of AI servers.

items.title: 長榮Q3單季獲利倍增 一季賺超過2個股本 EPS創單季第三高
items.title_en: Evergreen Marine Q3 profit doubles, quarterly earnings exceed twice equity, EPS sets third-highest quarterly record
paras: 貨櫃航商長榮(2603-TW)今(12)日公布第三季財報，單季合併營收1467.76億元，年增51.44%，稅後純益更衝上466.15億元，年增114.36%，每股純益(EPS)21.53元，EPS創單季第三高紀錄。
長榮前三季合併營收3384.49億元，年增15.36%，稅後純益達709.53億元，年增18.13%，EPS 32.77元。
長榮表示，第三季延續第二季需求動能，全季維持旺季格局，同時，因地緣政治、疊加全球主要樞紐港口壅塞，稀釋市場的實質有效運力，使供需結構緊俏，進一步推升第三季的營收和獲利表現。
展望未來，長榮表示，將持續發揮靈活的營運韌性，透過航線網絡優化和貨載結構分流，最大化船隊與貨櫃資產的運用效率。
同時，配合公司長期戰略藍圖，長榮將持續推進全球關鍵碼頭和物流基礎設施布局，藉由強化海陸整合優勢來抵禦產業週期波動。
paras_en: Container shipping company Evergreen Marine (2603-TW) today (12th) released its third‑quarter financial results, reporting combined revenue of NT$1,467.76 billion for the quarter, up 51.44% year‑on‑year, and net profit after tax soaring to NT$466.15 billion, up 114.36% year‑on‑year. Earnings per share (EPS) were NT$21.53, marking the third‑highest EPS ever recorded for a single quarter.

For the first three quarters, Evergreen’s combined revenue reached NT$3,384.49 billion, a 15.36% year‑on‑year increase, and net profit after tax amounted to NT$709.53 billion, up 18.13% year‑on‑year, with EPS of NT$32.77.

Evergreen said the third quarter continued the demand momentum of the second quarter, maintaining a peak‑season pattern throughout the quarter. At the same time, geopolitical tensions and congestion at major global hub ports have diluted the market’s effective capacity, tightening the supply‑demand balance and further boosting revenue and profit performance in the third quarter.

Looking ahead, Evergreen stated it will continue to leverage its operational flexibility, optimizing route networks and diversifying cargo structures to maximize the utilization efficiency of its fleet and container assets.

In line with its long‑term strategic blueprint, Evergreen will keep advancing the development of key global terminals and logistics infrastructure, strengthening its sea‑land integration advantage to cushion against industry cycle fluctuations.

items.title: 〈台灣大法說〉前三季EPS 4.26元 估精誠淨利貢獻將提升至12.26億元
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Q1‑Q3 EPS 4.26 NTD; Estimated Net Profit Contribution from KGI Information to Rise to 1.226 B NTD
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(12)日公布財報並召開法說會，台灣大前三季稅後純益達129.5億元，年增超過2成，每股純益4.26元。台灣大近日完成精誠資訊(6214-TW)公開收購普通股，並推估在未考量相關利息支出的情況下，對台灣大的淨利貢獻將提升至12.26 億元，約為收購前的5.2倍。
台灣大旗下台信電訊公開收購精誠資訊普通股案已完成，總計收購精誠已發行股份 49.16%，加計台灣大原持有的11.86%股權，交易完成後總持股將達61.02%。交易對價包含現金約124億元，與台灣大普通股約1.124 億股。依擬制性資產負債表試算，收購後台灣大合併總資產將增加至3,000億元。
台灣大進一步指出，在獲利貢獻上，以精誠今年前三季獲利為基礎，在未考量相關利息支出的情況下進行擬制試算，精誠對台灣大的淨利貢獻將由約2.34億元提升至12.26 億元，約為收購前的5.2倍。
Telco電信本業上，整體行動及加護事業營收第三季年增8%。行動服務營收170.5億元，年增3%，創歷史新高，其中，5G占比達7成。智慧型手機月租用戶ARPU達697元，年增3%，且月租用戶退租率僅0.48%。智慧型手機5G滲透率提升至46%，4G用戶續約升轉5G後，月租費平均上升幅度達 47%。家計用戶事業收入則年增14%，其中，寬頻業務營收年增 5%。
Telco+企業電信事業方面受惠各項業務持續貢獻，第三季整體營收年增 34%。其中，AIDC等資料中心業務營收年增1.4倍，企業資通訊服務營收年增2.84倍，資安服務營收年增53%，IoT物聯網服務營收年增23%，行動廣告聯播網營收(含商務簡訊與行動廣告)則年增10%。專為中小企業、餐飲及零售店家打造的一站式智慧解決方案「OP 開店包」用戶數則年增37%。
Telco+Tech 新科技電信事業部分，第三季營收(不計入momo)年增 14%，包含電信帳單代收代付服務「大哥付隨帳收」、品牌電商、遊戲發行，以及 MyVideo、OTT 服務及內容投資。其中，品牌電商營收年增86%，OTT 服務與內容投資營收年增26%。
台灣大第三季營收503.7億元，季增1.88%，年增8.68%；EBITDA 113.14億元，季減1.59%，年增6.45%；稅後純益42.6億元，季減6.15%，年增18.61%，每股純益1.4元。
台灣大累計今年前三季營收1495.8億元，年增5.36%；EBITDA 341.65億元，年增7.53%；稅後純益129.5億元，年增22.87%，每股純益4.26元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) announced its financial results and held a earnings presentation on December 12. The company’s net profit after tax for the first three quarters reached 12.95 billion NTD, an increase of more than 20% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 4.26 NTD. Taiwan Mobile recently completed a public acquisition of ordinary shares of KGI Information (6214‑TW) and estimates that, before accounting for related interest expenses, the acquisition will lift its net profit contribution to 1.226 billion NTD, roughly 5.2 times the pre‑acquisition level.

Taiwan Mobile’s subsidiary, Tainan Telecom, has completed the acquisition of ordinary shares of KGI Information. The total acquisition covers 49.16% of KGI’s issued shares, plus Taiwan Mobile’s existing 11.86% stake, bringing the combined holding to 61.02%. The transaction price includes about 12.4 billion NTD in cash and roughly 112.4 million shares of Taiwan Mobile common stock. According to a provisional balance sheet trial, the consolidated assets of Taiwan Mobile will increase to 300 billion NTD after the acquisition.

Taiwan Mobile further clarified that, based on KGI’s profit for the first three quarters of the year, a provisional calculation excluding related interest expenses shows KGI’s contribution to Taiwan Mobile’s net profit will rise from about 234 million NTD to 1.226 billion NTD, approximately 5.2 times the pre‑acquisition figure.

In its core telecom operations, overall mobile and broadband revenue grew 8% year‑on‑year in the third quarter. Mobile services revenue reached 17.05 billion NTD, up 3% and hitting a record high, with 5G accounting for 70% of the total. The average revenue per user (ARPU) for monthly‑rent smartphone users was 697 NTD, up 3% year‑on‑year, and the churn rate for monthly‑rent users was only 0.48%. Smartphone 5G penetration rose to 46%; after 4G users renewed and switched to 5G, the average monthly rent increased by 47%. Household user revenue grew 14% year‑on‑year, with broadband revenue up 5%.

In the Telco+ enterprise telecom segment, various businesses continued to contribute, with overall revenue up 34% year‑on‑year in the third quarter. Data center services such as AIDC grew 1.4 times, enterprise ICT services grew 2.84 times, cybersecurity services grew 53%, IoT services grew 23%, and mobile advertising and broadcast network revenue (including business SMS and mobile ads) grew 10%. The one‑stop smart solution “OP Open‑Store Package” for SMEs, restaurants, and retail stores saw user numbers grow 37% year‑on‑year.

In the Telco+Tech new‑technology telecom segment, third‑quarter revenue (excluding momo) grew 14% year‑on‑year, covering telecom bill collection and payment services “Da‑Ge Pay”, branded e‑commerce, game publishing, as well as MyVideo, OTT services, and content investment. Branded e‑commerce revenue grew 86% year‑on‑year, while OTT services and content investment revenue grew 26% year‑on‑year.

Taiwan Mobile’s third‑quarter revenue was 50.37 billion NTD, up 1.88% quarter‑on‑quarter and 8.68% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was 11.314 billion NTD, down 1.59% quarter‑on‑quarter but up 6.45% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was 4.26 billion NTD, down 6.15% quarter‑on‑quarter but up 18.61% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 1.4 NTD.

Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of the year was 149.58 billion NTD, up 5.36% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was 34.165 billion NTD, up 7.53% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was 12.95 billion NTD, up 22.87% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 4.26 NTD.

items.title: 輝達風波會拖垮AI行情？巴克萊：還不到離場時候
items.title_en: Will the Nvidia Scandal Drag Down the AI Market? Barclays: Not Yet Time to Exit
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)高層風波與人工智慧(AI)投資的融資風險升溫，但巴克萊(BCS-US)私人銀行首席市場策略師Julien Lafargue認為，這些挑戰尚不足以扭轉AI產業的長期發展方向，投資人仍應維持布局，同時留意利率與融資環境變化。
據《彭博》報導，Lafargue接受《彭博電視》訪問時，提前透露巴克萊即將發布、題為「直到音樂停止」(Until the Music Stops)的2027年展望。他表示，巴克萊仍認為持續參與市場具有充分理由，並將AI視為一場影響各行各業的技術革命。
他說：「對我們而言，這不是泡沫，而是一場將影響每個產業的技術革命，但我們必須認清，這不會一夕之間發生。」
輝達周四盤前股價下跌5.7%。《華爾街日報》報導，在黃仁勳遭指涉及婚外情、其中一名對象疑為中國間諜的消息曝光後，輝達董事正準備撤換其執行長職務。另有知情人士向《彭博》透露，董事會已委託外部公司尋找接班人選，並考慮任命臨時執行長。
對於這場高層風波，Lafargue指出，輝達雖被稱為「AI交易的中央銀行」，但即使執行長更換，也不代表每筆交易都必須重新審查與協商。
他以微軟(MSFT-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)的領導人交接為例，認為這些企業從具有鮮明個人魅力的領袖交棒給繼任者，並未因此減損公司價值。
不過，Lafargue也承認，國家安全疑慮可能促使美國採取更嚴格措施，限制輝達或其他美國製造晶片出口，進而衝擊相關產業。儘管如此，若將時間拉長至未來兩至三年，產業發展方向仍然明確，美國與其他市場的競爭及創新將帶來新技術，逐步淡化短期干擾。
相較於個別企業的人事變動，他認為，整體AI投資更需要重新調整對算力建置速度的期待。市場雖已承諾投入數兆美元，但相關設施與運算能力無法在短時間內全部建置到位，資金投入與實際產能上線之間仍有落差。
Lafargue表示，巴克萊已列出12項可能撼動市場的因素，其中最重大的風險來自利率與融資條件。這也意味著，投資人除了關注AI技術前景，還必須持續評估支撐龐大投資的資金環境。
他說：「我們希望參與市場，並持續投資，直到看見音樂開始慢下來的跡象。」
paras_en: The Nvidia (NVDA-US) executive turmoil and rising financing risks for AI investments have prompted Barclays (BCS-US) Private Bank Chief Market Strategist Julien Lafargue to argue that these challenges are not yet enough to reverse the long‑term trajectory of the AI industry; investors should maintain their positions while monitoring interest rates and financing conditions.

According to Bloomberg, Lafargue revealed in a Bloomberg TV interview that Barclays will soon release a 2027 outlook titled "Until the Music Stops." He said Barclays still sees ample reasons to stay in the market and views AI as a technological revolution affecting all industries.
He said, "For us, this is not a bubble, but a technological revolution that will affect every industry, though we must recognize it will not happen overnight."

Nvidia's pre‑market share fell 5.7% on Thursday. The Wall Street Journal reported that after rumors surfaced that CEO Jensen Huang was involved in an affair with a woman suspected to be a Chinese spy, the board was preparing to replace him. Bloomberg sources also said the board had commissioned an external firm to find a successor and was considering appointing an interim CEO.
Regarding the executive turmoil, Lafargue noted that Nvidia is dubbed the "central bank of AI trading," but even if the CEO changes, it does not mean every trade must be re‑reviewed and renegotiated.

He cited the leadership transitions at Microsoft (MSFT-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US), and Amazon (AMZN-US) as examples, arguing that these companies passed leadership from charismatic figures to successors without eroding company value.

However, Lafargue acknowledged that national‑security concerns could prompt the U.S. to impose stricter measures, limiting Nvidia or other U.S. chipmakers' exports and impacting related industries. Still, over a two‑to‑three‑year horizon, the industry direction remains clear, with U.S. and other markets competing and innovating to gradually mitigate short‑term disruptions.

Compared to individual corporate personnel changes, he believes overall AI investment needs to readjust expectations for the speed of computing infrastructure deployment. Although markets have pledged trillions of dollars, the facilities and computing capacity cannot be fully built in the short term, leaving a gap between capital outlay and actual capacity online.

Lafargue said Barclays has identified 12 factors that could shake the market, with the biggest risk stemming from interest rates and financing conditions. This means investors must not only focus on AI technology prospects but also continuously assess the funding environment that supports large investments.
He added, "We want to stay in the market and keep investing until we see signs that the music is slowing down."

items.title: 傳輝達物色新掌門！外媒專欄挺黃仁勳留任 開出「分權」條件
items.title_en: NVIDIA Seeks New CEO Amid Scandal; Analysts Back Jensen Huang’s Continuation with “Decentralized” Conditions
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情後，董事會已聘請外部律師展開調查。《MarketWatch》專欄作家 David Weidner 同日稍早撰文主張，輝達應讓黃仁勳留任，同時任命獨立董事長、公開接班計畫，並讓其他高階主管承擔更多對外溝通與決策責任。
花旗示警　換帥牽動產品策略與客戶關係
多家媒體報導，輝達董事會週三 (11 日) 將開會討論黃仁勳的去留，最快週三將會有結果，而且公司已委託外部機構物色接班人人選。
花旗分析師指出，黃仁勳在公司策略、產品方向、客戶關係與投資人信心上扮演核心角色，領導層若出現變動，相關不確定性將持續壓抑股價。
持有輝達股票的 Minotaur Capital 共同創辦人兼投資組合經理 Armina Rosenberg 認為，擔任輝達財務長逾十年的柯蕾絲 (Colette Kress) 是合理的代理執行長人選，但投資人更在意的是，長期將由誰主導輝達的技術路線圖。
科技分析師 Dan Ives 本週稍早認為，黃仁勳遭撤換或自行請辭的機率偏低，理由是輝達的人工智慧 (AI) 業務與黃仁勳的領導密切相關，現有管理團隊也缺乏能立即接手的人選。
不過，他指出，黃仁勳的去留仍取決於董事會調查結果，短期內將是股價的壓力來源。
接班安排缺乏能見度　籲董事會強化監督
Weidner 以蘋果 (AAPL-US) 為例，指出蘋果曾讓市場有時間認識接班人，消化領導層交棒的變化。
相較之下，黃仁勳長期代表輝達發表新品、說明技術方向，投資人對其他主管的決策角色所知有限。
Weidner 認為，輝達董事會應立即任命獨立董事長，對外說明接班安排，並提高其他高階主管的能見度，讓市場能評估各自的職責與接班能力。
Weidner 也指出，輝達部分晶片出口許可涉及與美國政府分享營收的安排。
華府有理由釐清黃仁勳曾與哪些人接觸、是否分享敏感資訊，並循國家安全程序處理。
指數權重放大波動　AI 客戶融資也受關注
依 Weidner 撰文時引用的數據，輝達市值約 4 兆美元，占標普 500 指數約 6.5%、那斯達克 100 指數約 13%。這意味著，輝達股價大幅波動時，持有追蹤這兩項指數基金的投資人也會受到影響。
Weidner 也把輝達對 AI 客戶提供的融資支持列為估值風險。
Vantage Point Asset Management 投資長費瑞斯 (Nick Ferres) 則指出，部分接受輝達資金支持的企業正興建採用輝達晶片的資料中心。一旦 AI 投資放緩，這些客戶也可能面臨壓力。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, prompting the board to hire external counsel to investigate. MarketWatch columnist David Weidner wrote earlier that day urging NVIDIA to keep Huang in place while appointing an independent chairman, launching a public succession plan, and assigning greater external communication and decision‑making responsibilities to other senior executives.
Citigroup warns that a leadership change could affect product strategy and customer relationships.

Multiple media outlets reported that NVIDIA’s board will meet on Wednesday, the 11th, to discuss Huang’s future, with a decision expected as early as Wednesday, and the company has already commissioned an external firm to identify potential successors.

Citigroup analysts noted that Huang plays a central role in the company’s strategy, product direction, customer relationships, and investor confidence; any leadership change would introduce uncertainty that could suppress the stock price.

Minotaur Capital co‑founder and portfolio manager Armina Rosenberg, who holds NVIDIA shares, believes Colette Kress, who has served as CFO for over a decade, is a reasonable interim CEO candidate, but investors are more concerned about who will ultimately steer NVIDIA’s technology roadmap.

Tech analyst Dan Ives, earlier this week, opined that the probability of Huang being removed or resigning voluntarily is low, citing NVIDIA’s AI business’s close ties to his leadership and the lack of an immediate successor within the current management team.
However, he added that Huang’s fate still depends on the board’s investigation results, which will be a short‑term pressure on the stock price.
The succession plan lacks visibility, urging the board to strengthen oversight.
Weidner used Apple (AAPL-US) as an example, noting that Apple gave the market time to learn about its successor and absorb leadership transition changes.
In contrast, Huang has long represented NVIDIA in product launches and technical direction, leaving investors with limited knowledge of other executives’ decision‑making roles.

Weidner believes NVIDIA’s board should immediately appoint an independent chairman, publicly disclose the succession plan, and increase the visibility of other senior executives so the market can assess their responsibilities and succession capabilities.
Weidner also pointed out that some of NVIDIA’s chip export licenses involve arrangements to share revenue with the U.S. government.
The U.S. government has reason to clarify which individuals Huang has contacted, whether sensitive information was shared, and to handle matters according to national security procedures.
Index weight amplification creates volatility; AI customer financing also draws attention.

According to data cited by Weidner at the time of writing, NVIDIA’s market cap is about $4 trillion, accounting for roughly 6.5% of the S&P 500 and about 13% of the Nasdaq 100. This means that when NVIDIA’s stock price fluctuates sharply, investors holding funds tracking these two indices will also be affected.
Weidner also listed NVIDIA’s financing support for AI customers as a valuation risk.

Nick Ferres, chief investment officer of Vantage Point Asset Management, noted that some companies receiving NVIDIA funding are building data centers that use NVIDIA chips. If AI investment slows, these customers may also face pressure.

items.title: 【鴻海法說會】AI重點筆記 2026/11/12
items.title_en: Foxconn Q3 2026 Earnings Call: AI Highlights
paras: 一、第三季營運及財務表現
第三季營收3.02兆元，年增46%、季增19%；毛利1,815億元，年增39%、季增17%；營業利益1,154億元，年增64%、季增22%。
稅後純益775.24億元，年增34%、季增29%，創歷年單季新高，每股純益5.51元。
第三季毛利率6.02%、營業利益率3.83%、淨利率2.57%。
累計前三季營收7.66兆元，年增39%；毛利4,670億元，年增35%；營業利益2,858億元，年增65%；稅後純益1,874.17億元，年增30%，每股純益13.35元。
前三季毛利率6.10%、營業利益率3.73%、淨利率2.45%，本業獲利能力持續優化。
二、第四季展望及全年四大產品展望全面上調
第四季AI業務持續成長，加上ICT產品進入傳統旺季，預期整體營收季增、年增均將強勁成長。
雲端網路產品：受惠新一代AI伺服器機櫃出貨，AI伺服器營收預期持續季增，通用伺服器維持溫和成長，整體雲端網路產品季增顯著、年增強勁。
消費智能產品：進入第四季出貨高峰，需求良好，加上出貨價格提高，預期季增、年增均強勁成長。
電腦終端產品：受記憶體供應緊張影響，預期季減，但部分零組件價格上漲帶動出貨價格提高，年增仍顯著。
元件及其他產品：受惠主要業務相關零組件出貨增加，預期季增顯著。
全年維持強勁成長目標不變，因營運能見度較8月法說會時改善，四大產品展望全面上調。
三、2027年營運展望正向 關鍵零組件仍供應吃緊
劉揚偉表示，從目前掌握的客戶需求來看，對2027年營運持續成長具有信心，且今年營運表現幾乎均高於原先預期，相關趨勢可望延續至明年。
晶片、記憶體及部分關鍵零組件供應吃緊，仍是AI與消費電子產業共同面臨的挑戰。
雖然新產能陸續開出可望逐步緩解供應瓶頸，但預期明年整體需求仍大於供給，供需吃緊情況可能持續一段時間。
全球政經環境、通膨、利率及匯率變化，仍可能影響營運成本、投資決策與供應鏈布局。
四、AI業務帶動獲利結構改善 ROE逐步提升
隨著雲端網路產品去年成為集團最大營收來源，鴻海ROE已由過去以消費智能及電腦終端產品為主時期的低於10%，提升至超過11%。
今年前三季ROE達10.44%，逐步接近全年12%的目標，內部已開始討論下一階段更高的ROE目標。
今年前三季營業利益年增65%，高於營收年增39%及毛利年增35%，顯示垂直整合、自動化及營運效率改善，持續帶動本業獲利能力提升。
前三季營業利益率達3.73%，高於去年全年3.2%，也超過公司設定的3%底線。
五、EBITDA成長強勁 支持資本支出與股東回饋
2025年EBITDA接近3,570億元，相較2020年成長超過一倍。
今年前三季EBITDA達3,692億元，已超越去年全年，年增1,236億元、增幅50.3%，高於同期資本支出43%的增幅。
EBITDA與資本支出及現金股利之間的差距持續擴大，顯示本業現金創造能力提升，可支應AI相關投資、未來資本支出及股東回饋。
資金管理秉持「以長支長、以短支短」原則，以長期資金支應長期投資，短期營運需求則透過借款及現金轉換週期靈活調度。
集團負債比率約64%，未來仍有發行公司債的空間，也將彈性運用以可轉換公司債為主的股權相關籌資工具，兼顧資金成本及籌資幣別多元性。
QA 重點摘要
一、2027年營運展望：維持雙位數成長，AI仍是核心動能
董事長劉揚偉對2027年營運維持審慎樂觀看法，預期集團營運可維持雙位數成長。
IMF預估2027年全球經濟成長率約3.4%，高於今年的3.1%，但產業仍呈現K型發展。
AI相關產業受惠全球算力需求及基礎建設投資，成長動能強勁；其他ICT產品則可能受到記憶體供應吃緊、零組件成本上升影響。
四大產品展望：
雲端網路產品： 2027年最主要成長動能，受惠CSP持續擴大AI資本支出，帶動AI伺服器及高速網路設備需求。今年營收占比已超過五成，未來3至5年可望提升至六成以上。
消費智能產品： 主要客戶產品以高階為主，受到記憶體短缺影響相對有限，加上新產品開發及規格升級需求，預期2027年表現相對穩定。
電腦產品： 看法相對審慎，記憶體供應緊張及零組件漲價，可能推升終端售價、影響消費者換機意願。
電動車： 海外專案明年陸續進入量產及交付階段，加上新車型開始商業化，預期相關營收持續成長。
二、AI需求及客戶拉貨：目前未見放緩，長期政策變數仍待觀察
劉揚偉指出，目前觀察到AI需求持續增加，主要來自四大類使用者，包括模型開發商、CSP、政府及企業，其中目前以模型開發商及CSP為主要算力需求來源。
從終端使用者需求來看，帶動CSP及新興雲端業者持續擴大算力建置，目前尚未看到AI投資或客戶拉貨動能減緩。
已經下訂單、決定建置資料中心的客戶，短期可能加快算力部署速度。
美國期中選舉及產業變化，短期對AI投資影響有限，但長期仍須觀察政策及市場變數。
鴻海在美國設有生產基地，從第一線觀察，客戶AI基礎建設建置進度目前仍相當積極。
三、AI伺服器及新一代機櫃：出貨維持高雙位數成長
面對新一代AI伺服器機櫃轉換，劉揚偉表示，鴻海透過自動化及集團垂直整合，已大幅降低過去伺服器製造常見的問題，目前未看到新產品轉換帶來明顯陣痛。
Q4及2027年AI伺服器出貨量均維持高雙位數成長展望。
即使營收成長幅度可能受到交易模式改變影響，機櫃層級的實際出貨量仍可望維持高雙位數成長。
未來需持續觀察資料中心是否準備就緒、能否順利部署機櫃，這將是影響出貨進度的重要因素。
四、ASIC成長加速：第三季出貨年增1.5倍，明年成長動能可望更強
大型CSP及模型開發商持續加大自研晶片投入，AI應用也從模型訓練逐步擴展至推論，帶動ASIC需求快速增加。
劉揚偉指出，目前鴻海與主要CSP客戶在ASIC專案上均有不同程度合作。
ASIC客製化程度高，涵蓋系統架構、主機板、電源、液冷散熱、高速連接及機櫃結構等，正好可發揮鴻海垂直整合優勢。
第三季鴻海ASIC AI伺服器出貨量年增1.5倍，高於GPU AI伺服器約70%的成長幅度。
展望2027年，GPU及ASIC出貨都將持續成長，但ASIC受惠AI推論及AI Agent應用增加，成長速度有機會更快。
調研機構預估，ASIC AI伺服器出貨占比將從2026年的27.8%，提升至2030年的40%。
鴻海希望隨ASIC業務成長，不僅增加系統組裝，也進一步提高零組件業務貢獻。
部分ASIC專案採Consignment（寄售）模式，晶片成本不會計入鴻海營收，因此營收占比可能低於實際出貨量占比。
這類模式有助降低營運資金占用、提高資金使用效率。
五、CPO及光通訊：看好電轉光趨勢，垂直整合具優勢
劉揚偉看好CPO及光通訊長期發展，認為隨著大型語言模型（LLM）對記憶體頻寬需求提高、模型規模持續擴大，從電傳輸轉向光傳輸的趨勢不會改變。
未來關鍵在於解決工程及製造問題，包括光纖連接器、光電轉換器，以及大量光纖在微小範圍內的精準對位。
鴻海具備微米級精密加工能力，可應用於光纖及光電元件的高精度製造。
集團已具備從Cable到CPO Switch的完整產品能力，透過垂直整合提供整體解決方案。
鴻海對CPO相關業務未來成長機會抱持高度看好態度。
六、獲利能力：垂直整合零組件規模擴大，長期維持3%以上目標
財務長指出，今年前三季營業淨利率達3.73%，較去年同期3.16%增加0.57個百分點，預期全年營業淨利率也將優於去年的3.2%。
中長期營業淨利率維持3%以上目標不變。
面對AI伺服器單價提高、零組件成本及產品複雜度增加，將透過產品組合優化、規模經濟、自動化及關鍵零組件垂直整合提升獲利能力。
劉揚偉進一步透露，集團垂直整合零組件業務規模，去年約1.3兆元，今年已超過1.6兆元，且相關業務毛利率高於五成。
隨著零組件自製比例提高，有助拉升整體平均毛利率及營業利益率。
ASIC及ASIC機櫃客製化需求較高，需要更多客製化零組件，也有利於鴻海提高垂直整合及零組件業務貢獻。
七、現金流及資本支出：AI擴張帶動資金需求，全年自由現金流仍待觀察
鴻海將持續透過Consignment等交易模式，降低營運資金占用。
加強應收帳款、存貨及應付帳款管理，提升現金週轉效率。
隨AI業務快速成長，高階零組件備料、存貨及應付帳款同步擴大，加上擴產需求，資本支出及資金投入也會增加。
公司強調，目前資金支出是掌握AI基礎建設商機的必要投入，背後有T1客戶明確訂單及長期需求支持。

資金管理將依「短支短、長支長」原則，搭配營業現金流及融資工具支應資金需求。

與東元的合作屬於長期策略性投資，希望為集團未來發展及成長布局。

paras_en: 1. Q3 Operations and Financial Performance
2. Q3 revenue was T$3.02 trillion, up 46% YoY and 19% QoQ; gross profit T$181.5 billion, up 39% YoY and 17% QoQ; operating profit T$115.4 billion, up 64% YoY and 22% QoQ.
3. Net income after tax was T$77.524 billion, up 34% YoY and 29% QoQ, a record single‑quarter high, with earnings per share of NT$5.51.
4. Q3 gross margin was 6.02%, operating margin 3.83% and net margin 2.57%.

5. Cumulative first‑three‑quarters revenue was T$7.66 trillion, up 39% YoY; gross profit T$467 billion, up 35% YoY; operating profit T$285.8 billion, up 65% YoY; net income T$187.417 billion, up 30% YoY; earnings per share NT$13.35.
6. First‑three‑quarters gross margin 6.10%, operating margin 3.73% and net margin 2.45%, showing continued improvement in core profitability.
7. Q4 outlook and full‑year product outlook all raised
8. Q4 AI business continues to grow, and with ICT products entering the traditional peak season, overall revenue is expected to grow strongly both QoQ and YoY.

9. Cloud and networking products: benefited by shipments of next‑generation AI server racks, AI server revenue is expected to continue QoQ growth, general servers remain modestly growing, overall cloud and networking products show significant QoQ growth and strong YoY growth.
10. Consumer smart products: entering Q4 shipment peak, demand is good, plus higher shipment prices, expected to grow strongly both QoQ and YoY.
11. Computer terminal products: affected by tight memory supply, expected QoQ decline, but some component price increases lift shipment prices, YoY growth remains significant.
12. Components and other products: benefited by increased shipments of key components related to main business, expected QoQ growth to be significant.
13. Full‑year growth target remains unchanged, as operational visibility improved since the August earnings call, all four product outlooks have been raised.
14. 2027 operating outlook remains positive, key components still face supply constraints

15. Liu Yang‑wei stated that based on current customer demand, confidence in continued growth in 2027 remains high, and this year’s performance has almost all exceeded original expectations, with trends likely to continue next year.
16. Chips, memory and some key components remain tight, a challenge shared by AI and consumer electronics industries.
17. Although new capacity is gradually coming online to ease bottlenecks, overall demand is expected to remain above supply next year, and supply‑demand tightness may persist for some time.
18. Global political and economic environment, inflation, interest rates and currency fluctuations may still affect operating costs, investment decisions and supply‑chain layout.
19. AI business drives profitability structure improvement, ROE gradually rises

20. With cloud and networking products becoming the group’s largest revenue source last year, Foxconn’s ROE has risen from below 10% during the period when consumer smart and computer terminal products dominated to over 11%.
21. First‑three‑quarters ROE this year reached 10.44%, gradually approaching the 12% annual target, and internal discussions have begun on a higher next‑stage ROE target.

22. First‑three‑quarters operating profit grew 65% YoY, higher than revenue growth of 39% and gross profit growth of 35%, showing vertical integration, automation and operational efficiency improvements continue to lift core profitability.
23. First‑three‑quarters operating margin reached 3.73%, higher than last year’s 3.2% and above the company’s 3% baseline.
24. EBITDA growth is strong, supporting capital expenditure and shareholder returns
25. 2025 EBITDA is close to T$357 billion, more than double the 2020 level.

26. First‑three‑quarters EBITDA this year reached T$369.2 billion, surpassing last year’s full‑year figure, up T$123.6 billion or 50.3%, higher than the 43% increase in capital expenditure during the same period.

27. The gap between EBITDA and capital expenditure and cash dividends continues to widen, showing improved cash‑generating ability of the core business, able to support AI‑related investment, future capital expenditure and shareholder returns.

28. Cash management follows the principle of “long‑term spend for long‑term, short‑term spend for short‑term”, using long‑term funds for long‑term investment and flexibly allocating short‑term operating needs through borrowing and cash conversion cycles.

29. The group’s debt ratio is about 64%, leaving room for future corporate bond issuance, and convertible bonds will be flexibly used as equity‑related financing tools, balancing funding cost and currency diversity.
30. QA highlights
31. 2027 operating outlook: maintain double‑digit growth, AI remains core momentum
32. Chairman Liu Yang‑wei maintains a cautiously optimistic view for 2027, expecting the group to sustain double‑digit growth.
33. IMF estimates global economic growth in 2027 at about 3.4%, higher than this year’s 3.1%, but industry still shows a K‑shaped development.

34. AI‑related industries benefit from global computing power demand and infrastructure investment, with strong growth momentum; other ICT products may be affected by tight memory supply and rising component costs.
35. Four product outlooks:

36. Cloud and networking products: the main growth driver in 2027, benefiting from CSPs continuously expanding AI capital expenditure, driving demand for AI servers and high‑speed networking equipment. Revenue share already exceeds 50% this year, expected to rise to over 60% in the next 3‑5 years.

37. Consumer smart products: main customer products are high‑end, relatively unaffected by memory shortages, and with new product development and specification upgrades, 2027 performance is expected to be relatively stable.
38. Computer products: outlook is more cautious, tight memory supply and rising component prices may push up terminal prices and affect consumer upgrade willingness.
39. Electric vehicles: overseas projects will enter mass production and delivery next year, and new vehicle models will begin commercialization, with related revenue expected to continue growing.
40. AI demand and customer pull: no sign of slowdown, long‑term policy variables still to be observed

41. Liu Yang‑wei noted that AI demand continues to rise, mainly from the four user categories: model developers, CSPs, government and enterprises, with model developers and CSPs currently the main power‑capacity demand sources.
42. From end‑user demand, CSPs and emerging cloud operators continue to expand computing capacity, and no slowdown in AI investment or customer pull has been seen yet.
43. Customers who have already placed orders and decided to build data centers may accelerate deployment in the short term.
44. U.S. midterm elections and industry changes have limited short‑term impact on AI investment, but long‑term policy and market variables remain to be observed.
45. Foxconn has a production base in the U.S.; from the front line, customer AI infrastructure deployment progress remains very active.
46. AI servers and next‑generation racks: shipments maintain double‑digit growth

47. Facing the transition to next‑generation AI server racks, Liu Yang‑wei said Foxconn has greatly reduced the common manufacturing issues through automation and vertical integration, and no obvious pain has been seen from the new product transition.
48. Q4 and 2027 AI server shipments are expected to maintain high double‑digit growth outlooks.
49. Even if revenue growth may be affected by changes in transaction models, actual rack‑level shipments are expected to remain high double‑digit growth.
50. Future monitoring of data center readiness and successful rack deployment will be key to shipment progress.
51. ASIC growth accelerates: Q3 shipments grew 1.5× YoY, next‑year momentum expected to be stronger
52. Large CSPs and model developers continue to increase in‑house chip development, and AI applications are expanding from model training to inference, driving rapid ASIC demand growth.
53. Liu Yang‑wei noted that Foxconn and major CSP customers have varying degrees of cooperation on ASIC projects.

54. ASIC customization is high, covering system architecture, motherboard, power supply, liquid‑cooling, high‑speed interconnect and rack structure, leveraging Foxconn’s vertical integration advantage.
55. Q3 Foxconn ASIC AI server shipments grew 1.5× YoY, higher than GPU AI server growth of about 70%.
56. Looking ahead to 2027, GPU and ASIC shipments will continue to grow, but ASIC will benefit from increased AI inference and AI Agent applications, potentially growing faster.
57. Research firms estimate ASIC AI server shipments will rise from 27.8% of total in 2026 to 40% in 2030.
58. Foxconn hopes that with ASIC business growth, it will not only increase system assembly but also further raise component business contribution.
59. Some ASIC projects use a consignment model, so chip costs are not included in Foxconn revenue, meaning revenue share may be lower than actual shipment share.
60. This model helps reduce operating capital usage and improve capital efficiency.
61. CPO and optical communications: bullish on the electric‑to‑optical trend, vertical integration has advantages

62. Liu Yang‑wei is optimistic about long‑term development of CPO and optical communications, believing that as large language models (LLMs) increase memory bandwidth demand and model size continues to grow, the shift from electrical to optical transmission will not change.

63. The future focus is on solving engineering and manufacturing issues, including optical fiber connectors, optoelectronic converters, and precise alignment of large numbers of fibers in small areas.
64. Foxconn has micron‑level precision machining capability, applicable to high‑precision manufacturing of optical fibers and optoelectronic components.
65. The group already has a complete product capability from cable to CPO switch, providing integrated solutions through vertical integration.
66. Foxconn holds a highly optimistic view of future growth opportunities in CPO‑related business.
67. Profitability: vertical integration of component scale expands, long‑term target of over 3% maintained
68. CFO said first‑three‑quarters operating net margin reached 3.73%, up 0.57 percentage points from last year’s 3.16%, and full‑year operating net margin is expected to exceed last year’s 3.2%.
69. Medium‑to‑long‑term operating net margin remains above 3%.

70. Facing higher AI server unit prices, component costs and product complexity, profitability will be improved through product mix optimization, economies of scale, automation and vertical integration of key components.

71. Liu Yang‑wei further revealed that the group’s vertical integration component business grew from about T$1.3 trillion last year to over T$1.6 trillion this year, with related business gross margin above 50%.
72. Increasing the proportion of in‑house component production helps lift overall average gross margin and operating profit margin.
73. ASIC and ASIC rack customization demands are high, requiring more customized components, which also benefits Foxconn’s vertical integration and component business contribution.
74. Cash flow and capital expenditure: AI expansion drives funding demand, full‑year free cash flow still to be observed
75. Foxconn will continue to use consignment and other transaction models to reduce operating capital usage.
76. Strengthen management of accounts receivable, inventory and accounts payable to improve cash‑turnover efficiency.

77. With rapid AI business growth, high‑end component inventory, inventory and accounts payable will expand, and with expansion of production capacity, capital expenditure and funding will also increase.
78. The company emphasized that current funding is a necessary investment to capture AI infrastructure opportunities, backed by T1 customer orders and long‑term demand support.
79. Whether 2026 full‑year free cash flow remains positive depends on Q4 shipments, collection progress and actual capital expenditure execution.
80. Funding management follows the “short‑term spend for short‑term, long‑term spend for long‑term” principle, coupled with operating cash flow and financing tools to meet funding needs.
81. Electric vehicle investment: continued layout, but AI remains priority
82. Foxconn will continue to invest in the EV field, but compared to AI business, EV investment share is relatively small.
83. The EV industry is still being observed; when the right timing matures and readiness is achieved, the company will enter the market at scale.
84. The partnership with Tung‑Yuan is a long‑term strategic investment, aimed at future development and growth layout for the group.
85. Besides EV, robotics is also seen as an important direction for the group to find a second or third growth driver.
86. Consumer electronics: no comment on U.S. customer foldable phone shipments
87. Regarding the current production and shipment status of U.S. customer foldable phones, Liu Yang‑wei said it involves specific customers and products and will not comment.
88. As for the U.S. customer phone order situation this year, no further disclosure was made.

items.title: 高盛上修Fed利率預測 估12月、明年3月各升息一碼
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Raises Fed Rate Forecast, Projects One-Point Hike in December and Another in March 2027
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，美國 10 月通膨高於預期，高盛週三 (11 日) 上修聯準會 (Fed) 利率預測，除了維持 12 月升息一碼的看法，同時新增 2027 年 3 月再升息一碼的預測。
高盛經濟學家 David Mericle 指出，企業可能在明年 1 月調高售價，使年初通膨壓力加劇，促使 Fed 進一步收緊貨幣政策。
通膨前景連三個月惡化 高盛估點狀圖將釋升息訊號
高盛認為，綜合上週美國期中選舉結果及週二公布的通膨數據，Fed 可能需要把利率升到高於市場目前預期的水準。
Mericle指出，10 月通膨數據高於預期，通膨前景已連續第三個月惡化。Fed 理事華勒 (Christopher Waller) 同日在倫敦發表偏鷹談話，也讓市場開始押注 12 月升息兩碼的可能性。
Fed 將於 12 月 8 日至 9 日召開利率決策會議。報導當時，利率市場反映 12 月升息一碼的機率接近 90%，升息兩碼的機率約為 10%。
Mericle預期，Fed 可能在 12 月公布的利率點狀圖中，釋出明年仍有升息空間的訊號。若 Fed 如高盛預期在明年 3 月升息，將是本輪緊縮週期第三度調高利率。
油價回落減輕通膨壓力 高盛估明年底起降息四次
Mericle 表示，年初的漲價潮可能使 Fed 短期內維持緊縮，但近期油價下跌，顯示先前能源價格衝擊對消費者物價的影響大多已反映。
高盛預期，通膨可望在 2027 年底前降溫，Fed 將自 2027 年底起至 2028 年降息四次，最終把聯邦資金利率目標區間降至 3.25% 至 3.50%。目前的目標區間為 3.75% 至 4.00%。
通膨數據出爐後，美國公債週二 (10 日) 遭遇 2025 年 4 月以來最劇烈的賣壓。對 Fed 政策預期較敏感的 2 年期美債殖利率單日跳升 18 個基點，收在 4.75%。美國債市週三因退伍軍人節休市。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that U.S. inflation in October came in hotter than expected, prompting Goldman Sachs on Wednesday (the 11th) to raise its Federal Reserve rate forecasts. In addition to maintaining its view of a one‑point hike in December, it added a forecast for another one‑point increase in March 2027.

Goldman economist David Mericle noted that companies may raise prices in January next year, intensifying inflation pressures at the start of the year and prompting the Fed to tighten monetary policy further.
Inflation outlook has worsened for three consecutive months, and Goldman expects its dot‑plot to signal a rate hike.
Goldman believes that, taking into account last week’s U.S. midterm election results and Tuesday’s inflation data, the Fed may need to raise rates to a level higher than the market currently expects.

Mericle pointed out that October’s inflation data exceeded expectations, marking the third consecutive month of deteriorating inflation outlook. Fed Governor Christopher Waller delivered a hawkish speech in London the same day, leading markets to start betting on the possibility of a two‑point hike in December.

The Fed is set to meet on December 8‑9 to decide rates. At the time of reporting, the rate market reflected a near‑90% probability of a one‑point hike in December and about a 10% chance of a two‑point hike.

Mericle expects the Fed’s December dot‑plot to signal that there is still room for a rate increase next year. If the Fed follows Goldman’s expectation of a hike in March, it would be the third rate increase in this tightening cycle.
Falling oil prices ease inflation pressures, and Goldman projects four rate cuts starting at the end of next year.

Mericle said the early‑year price surge could keep the Fed in a tightening stance in the short term, but recent declines in oil prices suggest that the earlier energy price shock has largely been reflected in consumer prices.

Goldman forecasts that inflation should cool by the end of 2027, with the Fed cutting rates four times from the end of 2027 into 2028, ultimately lowering the federal funds target range to 3.25%‑3.50% from its current 3.75%‑4.00% range.

After the inflation data were released, U.S. Treasury bonds faced the strongest selling pressure since April 2025 on Tuesday the 10th. The two‑year Treasury yield, which is sensitive to Fed policy expectations, jumped 18 basis points in a single day to close at 4.75%. The U.S. bond market was closed on Wednesday for Veterans Day.

items.title: 博智越南新廠明年進入量產 有機會將伺服器板打入太空新專案
items.title_en: Bozhi Vietnam New Plant Enters Mass Production Next Year, Potential to Bring Server Boards into New Space Projects
paras: PCB廠博智(8155-TW)的越南新生產線將在明(2027)年進入量產，博智今(12)日召開法人說明會並指出，在產品應用方面，博智目前來自AI伺服器應用板仍是主要博智成長動能；同時，博智預期將伺服器板打入太空的新專案未來具參與機會。太空資料中心方面等同地上預期設計規格差異不大，但是不同平台仍有客製化的需求。
PCB廠博智1-9月營收48.11億元，稅後純益6.81億元，每股純益達11.15元公司表示，目前伺服器產品應用PCB仍為營收主力，營收占比約82%，主要是其他產品應用增加。
博智在越南投資設廠明年進入量產，爲公司與日本 Meiko (名幸電子)合資，且名幸電子本身就是 SpaceX 供應鏈，也因此博智越南廠進一步有機會再切入AI伺服器的天上版。
paras_en: PCB manufacturer Bozhi (8155-TW) says its new production line in Vietnam will enter mass production next year (2027). Bozhi held an investor briefing today (the 12th) and noted that in terms of product applications, its AI server application boards remain the main growth driver; at the same time, Bozhi expects opportunities to participate in new space projects that will incorporate server boards. For space data centers, the design specifications are not much different from ground‑based ones, but different platforms still require customization.

Bozhi reported revenue of NT$4.811 billion and net profit after tax of NT$681 million for January‑September, with earnings per share of NT$11.15. The company said server‑application PCBs remain the main revenue source, accounting for about 82% of sales, while other product applications are increasing.

Bozhi’s investment in a plant in Vietnam, which will start mass production next year, is a joint venture with Japan’s Meiko (Meiko Electronics). Meiko is itself part of the SpaceX supply chain, giving Bozhi’s Vietnam factory further chances to tap into the “sky‑version” of AI servers.

items.title: 長榮Q3單季獲利倍增 一季賺超過2個股本 EPS創單季第三高
items.title_en: Evergreen Marine Q3 profit doubles, quarterly earnings exceed twice equity, EPS sets third-highest quarterly record
paras: 貨櫃航商長榮(2603-TW)今(12)日公布第三季財報，單季合併營收1467.76億元，年增51.44%，稅後純益更衝上466.15億元，年增114.36%，每股純益(EPS)21.53元，EPS創單季第三高紀錄。
長榮前三季合併營收3384.49億元，年增15.36%，稅後純益達709.53億元，年增18.13%，EPS 32.77元。
長榮表示，第三季延續第二季需求動能，全季維持旺季格局，同時，因地緣政治、疊加全球主要樞紐港口壅塞，稀釋市場的實質有效運力，使供需結構緊俏，進一步推升第三季的營收和獲利表現。
展望未來，長榮表示，將持續發揮靈活的營運韌性，透過航線網絡優化和貨載結構分流，最大化船隊與貨櫃資產的運用效率。
同時，配合公司長期戰略藍圖，長榮將持續推進全球關鍵碼頭和物流基礎設施布局，藉由強化海陸整合優勢來抵禦產業週期波動。
paras_en: Container shipping company Evergreen Marine (2603-TW) today (12th) released its third‑quarter financial results, reporting combined revenue of NT$1,467.76 billion for the quarter, up 51.44% year‑on‑year, and net profit after tax soaring to NT$466.15 billion, up 114.36% year‑on‑year. Earnings per share (EPS) were NT$21.53, marking the third‑highest EPS ever recorded for a single quarter.

For the first three quarters, Evergreen’s combined revenue reached NT$3,384.49 billion, a 15.36% year‑on‑year increase, and net profit after tax amounted to NT$709.53 billion, up 18.13% year‑on‑year, with EPS of NT$32.77.

Evergreen said the third quarter continued the demand momentum of the second quarter, maintaining a peak‑season pattern throughout the quarter. At the same time, geopolitical tensions and congestion at major global hub ports have diluted the market’s effective capacity, tightening the supply‑demand balance and further boosting revenue and profit performance in the third quarter.

Looking ahead, Evergreen stated it will continue to leverage its operational flexibility, optimizing route networks and diversifying cargo structures to maximize the utilization efficiency of its fleet and container assets.

In line with its long‑term strategic blueprint, Evergreen will keep advancing the development of key global terminals and logistics infrastructure, strengthening its sea‑land integration advantage to cushion against industry cycle fluctuations.

items.title: 〈台灣大法說〉前三季EPS 4.26元 估精誠淨利貢獻將提升至12.26億元
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Q1‑Q3 EPS 4.26 NTD; Estimated Net Profit Contribution from KGI Information to Rise to 1.226 B NTD
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)今(12)日公布財報並召開法說會，台灣大前三季稅後純益達129.5億元，年增超過2成，每股純益4.26元。台灣大近日完成精誠資訊(6214-TW)公開收購普通股，並推估在未考量相關利息支出的情況下，對台灣大的淨利貢獻將提升至12.26 億元，約為收購前的5.2倍。
台灣大旗下台信電訊公開收購精誠資訊普通股案已完成，總計收購精誠已發行股份 49.16%，加計台灣大原持有的11.86%股權，交易完成後總持股將達61.02%。交易對價包含現金約124億元，與台灣大普通股約1.124 億股。依擬制性資產負債表試算，收購後台灣大合併總資產將增加至3,000億元。
台灣大進一步指出，在獲利貢獻上，以精誠今年前三季獲利為基礎，在未考量相關利息支出的情況下進行擬制試算，精誠對台灣大的淨利貢獻將由約2.34億元提升至12.26 億元，約為收購前的5.2倍。
Telco電信本業上，整體行動及加護事業營收第三季年增8%。行動服務營收170.5億元，年增3%，創歷史新高，其中，5G占比達7成。智慧型手機月租用戶ARPU達697元，年增3%，且月租用戶退租率僅0.48%。智慧型手機5G滲透率提升至46%，4G用戶續約升轉5G後，月租費平均上升幅度達 47%。家計用戶事業收入則年增14%，其中，寬頻業務營收年增 5%。
Telco+企業電信事業方面受惠各項業務持續貢獻，第三季整體營收年增 34%。其中，AIDC等資料中心業務營收年增1.4倍，企業資通訊服務營收年增2.84倍，資安服務營收年增53%，IoT物聯網服務營收年增23%，行動廣告聯播網營收(含商務簡訊與行動廣告)則年增10%。專為中小企業、餐飲及零售店家打造的一站式智慧解決方案「OP 開店包」用戶數則年增37%。
Telco+Tech 新科技電信事業部分，第三季營收(不計入momo)年增 14%，包含電信帳單代收代付服務「大哥付隨帳收」、品牌電商、遊戲發行，以及 MyVideo、OTT 服務及內容投資。其中，品牌電商營收年增86%，OTT 服務與內容投資營收年增26%。
台灣大第三季營收503.7億元，季增1.88%，年增8.68%；EBITDA 113.14億元，季減1.59%，年增6.45%；稅後純益42.6億元，季減6.15%，年增18.61%，每股純益1.4元。
台灣大累計今年前三季營收1495.8億元，年增5.36%；EBITDA 341.65億元，年增7.53%；稅後純益129.5億元，年增22.87%，每股純益4.26元。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) announced its financial results and held a earnings presentation on December 12. The company’s net profit after tax for the first three quarters reached 12.95 billion NTD, an increase of more than 20% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 4.26 NTD. Taiwan Mobile recently completed a public acquisition of ordinary shares of KGI Information (6214‑TW) and estimates that, before accounting for related interest expenses, the acquisition will lift its net profit contribution to 1.226 billion NTD, roughly 5.2 times the pre‑acquisition level.

Taiwan Mobile’s subsidiary, Tainan Telecom, has completed the acquisition of ordinary shares of KGI Information. The total acquisition covers 49.16% of KGI’s issued shares, plus Taiwan Mobile’s existing 11.86% stake, bringing the combined holding to 61.02%. The transaction price includes about 12.4 billion NTD in cash and roughly 112.4 million shares of Taiwan Mobile common stock. According to a provisional balance sheet trial, the consolidated assets of Taiwan Mobile will increase to 300 billion NTD after the acquisition.

Taiwan Mobile further clarified that, based on KGI’s profit for the first three quarters of the year, a provisional calculation excluding related interest expenses shows KGI’s contribution to Taiwan Mobile’s net profit will rise from about 234 million NTD to 1.226 billion NTD, approximately 5.2 times the pre‑acquisition figure.

In its core telecom operations, overall mobile and broadband revenue grew 8% year‑on‑year in the third quarter. Mobile services revenue reached 17.05 billion NTD, up 3% and hitting a record high, with 5G accounting for 70% of the total. The average revenue per user (ARPU) for monthly‑rent smartphone users was 697 NTD, up 3% year‑on‑year, and the churn rate for monthly‑rent users was only 0.48%. Smartphone 5G penetration rose to 46%; after 4G users renewed and switched to 5G, the average monthly rent increased by 47%. Household user revenue grew 14% year‑on‑year, with broadband revenue up 5%.

In the Telco+ enterprise telecom segment, various businesses continued to contribute, with overall revenue up 34% year‑on‑year in the third quarter. Data center services such as AIDC grew 1.4 times, enterprise ICT services grew 2.84 times, cybersecurity services grew 53%, IoT services grew 23%, and mobile advertising and broadcast network revenue (including business SMS and mobile ads) grew 10%. The one‑stop smart solution “OP Open‑Store Package” for SMEs, restaurants, and retail stores saw user numbers grow 37% year‑on‑year.

In the Telco+Tech new‑technology telecom segment, third‑quarter revenue (excluding momo) grew 14% year‑on‑year, covering telecom bill collection and payment services “Da‑Ge Pay”, branded e‑commerce, game publishing, as well as MyVideo, OTT services, and content investment. Branded e‑commerce revenue grew 86% year‑on‑year, while OTT services and content investment revenue grew 26% year‑on‑year.

Taiwan Mobile’s third‑quarter revenue was 50.37 billion NTD, up 1.88% quarter‑on‑quarter and 8.68% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was 11.314 billion NTD, down 1.59% quarter‑on‑quarter but up 6.45% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was 4.26 billion NTD, down 6.15% quarter‑on‑quarter but up 18.61% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 1.4 NTD.

Taiwan Mobile’s cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of the year was 149.58 billion NTD, up 5.36% year‑on‑year; EBITDA was 34.165 billion NTD, up 7.53% year‑on‑year; net profit after tax was 12.95 billion NTD, up 22.87% year‑on‑year, with earnings per share of 4.26 NTD.

items.title: 【鴻海法說會】AI重點筆記 2026/11/12
items.title_en: Foxconn Q3 2026 Earnings Call: AI Highlights
paras: 一、第三季營運及財務表現
第三季營收3.02兆元，年增46%、季增19%；毛利1,815億元，年增39%、季增17%；營業利益1,154億元，年增64%、季增22%。
稅後純益775.24億元，年增34%、季增29%，創歷年單季新高，每股純益5.51元。
第三季毛利率6.02%、營業利益率3.83%、淨利率2.57%。
累計前三季營收7.66兆元，年增39%；毛利4,670億元，年增35%；營業利益2,858億元，年增65%；稅後純益1,874.17億元，年增30%，每股純益13.35元。
前三季毛利率6.10%、營業利益率3.73%、淨利率2.45%，本業獲利能力持續優化。
二、第四季展望及全年四大產品展望全面上調
第四季AI業務持續成長，加上ICT產品進入傳統旺季，預期整體營收季增、年增均將強勁成長。
雲端網路產品：受惠新一代AI伺服器機櫃出貨，AI伺服器營收預期持續季增，通用伺服器維持溫和成長，整體雲端網路產品季增顯著、年增強勁。
消費智能產品：進入第四季出貨高峰，需求良好，加上出貨價格提高，預期季增、年增均強勁成長。
電腦終端產品：受記憶體供應緊張影響，預期季減，但部分零組件價格上漲帶動出貨價格提高，年增仍顯著。
元件及其他產品：受惠主要業務相關零組件出貨增加，預期季增顯著。
全年維持強勁成長目標不變，因營運能見度較8月法說會時改善，四大產品展望全面上調。
三、2027年營運展望正向 關鍵零組件仍供應吃緊
劉揚偉表示，從目前掌握的客戶需求來看，對2027年營運持續成長具有信心，且今年營運表現幾乎均高於原先預期，相關趨勢可望延續至明年。
晶片、記憶體及部分關鍵零組件供應吃緊，仍是AI與消費電子產業共同面臨的挑戰。
雖然新產能陸續開出可望逐步緩解供應瓶頸，但預期明年整體需求仍大於供給，供需吃緊情況可能持續一段時間。
全球政經環境、通膨、利率及匯率變化，仍可能影響營運成本、投資決策與供應鏈布局。
四、AI業務帶動獲利結構改善 ROE逐步提升
隨著雲端網路產品去年成為集團最大營收來源，鴻海ROE已由過去以消費智能及電腦終端產品為主時期的低於10%，提升至超過11%。
今年前三季ROE達10.44%，逐步接近全年12%的目標，內部已開始討論下一階段更高的ROE目標。
今年前三季營業利益年增65%，高於營收年增39%及毛利年增35%，顯示垂直整合、自動化及營運效率改善，持續帶動本業獲利能力提升。
前三季營業利益率達3.73%，高於去年全年3.2%，也超過公司設定的3%底線。
五、EBITDA成長強勁 支持資本支出與股東回饋
2025年EBITDA接近3,570億元，相較2020年成長超過一倍。
今年前三季EBITDA達3,692億元，已超越去年全年，年增1,236億元、增幅50.3%，高於同期資本支出43%的增幅。
EBITDA與資本支出及現金股利之間的差距持續擴大，顯示本業現金創造能力提升，可支應AI相關投資、未來資本支出及股東回饋。
資金管理秉持「以長支長、以短支短」原則，以長期資金支應長期投資，短期營運需求則透過借款及現金轉換週期靈活調度。
集團負債比率約64%，未來仍有發行公司債的空間，也將彈性運用以可轉換公司債為主的股權相關籌資工具，兼顧資金成本及籌資幣別多元性。
QA 重點摘要
一、2027年營運展望：維持雙位數成長，AI仍是核心動能
董事長劉揚偉對2027年營運維持審慎樂觀看法，預期集團營運可維持雙位數成長。
IMF預估2027年全球經濟成長率約3.4%，高於今年的3.1%，但產業仍呈現K型發展。
AI相關產業受惠全球算力需求及基礎建設投資，成長動能強勁；其他ICT產品則可能受到記憶體供應吃緊、零組件成本上升影響。
四大產品展望：
雲端網路產品： 2027年最主要成長動能，受惠CSP持續擴大AI資本支出，帶動AI伺服器及高速網路設備需求。今年營收占比已超過五成，未來3至5年可望提升至六成以上。
消費智能產品： 主要客戶產品以高階為主，受到記憶體短缺影響相對有限，加上新產品開發及規格升級需求，預期2027年表現相對穩定。
電腦產品： 看法相對審慎，記憶體供應緊張及零組件漲價，可能推升終端售價、影響消費者換機意願。
電動車： 海外專案明年陸續進入量產及交付階段，加上新車型開始商業化，預期相關營收持續成長。
二、AI需求及客戶拉貨：目前未見放緩，長期政策變數仍待觀察
劉揚偉指出，目前觀察到AI需求持續增加，主要來自四大類使用者，包括模型開發商、CSP、政府及企業，其中目前以模型開發商及CSP為主要算力需求來源。
從終端使用者需求來看，帶動CSP及新興雲端業者持續擴大算力建置，目前尚未看到AI投資或客戶拉貨動能減緩。
已經下訂單、決定建置資料中心的客戶，短期可能加快算力部署速度。
美國期中選舉及產業變化，短期對AI投資影響有限，但長期仍須觀察政策及市場變數。
鴻海在美國設有生產基地，從第一線觀察，客戶AI基礎建設建置進度目前仍相當積極。
三、AI伺服器及新一代機櫃：出貨維持高雙位數成長
面對新一代AI伺服器機櫃轉換，劉揚偉表示，鴻海透過自動化及集團垂直整合，已大幅降低過去伺服器製造常見的問題，目前未看到新產品轉換帶來明顯陣痛。
Q4及2027年AI伺服器出貨量均維持高雙位數成長展望。
即使營收成長幅度可能受到交易模式改變影響，機櫃層級的實際出貨量仍可望維持高雙位數成長。
未來需持續觀察資料中心是否準備就緒、能否順利部署機櫃，這將是影響出貨進度的重要因素。
四、ASIC成長加速：第三季出貨年增1.5倍，明年成長動能可望更強
大型CSP及模型開發商持續加大自研晶片投入，AI應用也從模型訓練逐步擴展至推論，帶動ASIC需求快速增加。
劉揚偉指出，目前鴻海與主要CSP客戶在ASIC專案上均有不同程度合作。
ASIC客製化程度高，涵蓋系統架構、主機板、電源、液冷散熱、高速連接及機櫃結構等，正好可發揮鴻海垂直整合優勢。
第三季鴻海ASIC AI伺服器出貨量年增1.5倍，高於GPU AI伺服器約70%的成長幅度。
展望2027年，GPU及ASIC出貨都將持續成長，但ASIC受惠AI推論及AI Agent應用增加，成長速度有機會更快。
調研機構預估，ASIC AI伺服器出貨占比將從2026年的27.8%，提升至2030年的40%。
鴻海希望隨ASIC業務成長，不僅增加系統組裝，也進一步提高零組件業務貢獻。
部分ASIC專案採Consignment（寄售）模式，晶片成本不會計入鴻海營收，因此營收占比可能低於實際出貨量占比。
這類模式有助降低營運資金占用、提高資金使用效率。
五、CPO及光通訊：看好電轉光趨勢，垂直整合具優勢
劉揚偉看好CPO及光通訊長期發展，認為隨著大型語言模型（LLM）對記憶體頻寬需求提高、模型規模持續擴大，從電傳輸轉向光傳輸的趨勢不會改變。
未來關鍵在於解決工程及製造問題，包括光纖連接器、光電轉換器，以及大量光纖在微小範圍內的精準對位。
鴻海具備微米級精密加工能力，可應用於光纖及光電元件的高精度製造。
集團已具備從Cable到CPO Switch的完整產品能力，透過垂直整合提供整體解決方案。
鴻海對CPO相關業務未來成長機會抱持高度看好態度。
六、獲利能力：垂直整合零組件規模擴大，長期維持3%以上目標
財務長指出，今年前三季營業淨利率達3.73%，較去年同期3.16%增加0.57個百分點，預期全年營業淨利率也將優於去年的3.2%。
中長期營業淨利率維持3%以上目標不變。
面對AI伺服器單價提高、零組件成本及產品複雜度增加，將透過產品組合優化、規模經濟、自動化及關鍵零組件垂直整合提升獲利能力。
劉揚偉進一步透露，集團垂直整合零組件業務規模，去年約1.3兆元，今年已超過1.6兆元，且相關業務毛利率高於五成。
隨著零組件自製比例提高，有助拉升整體平均毛利率及營業利益率。
ASIC及ASIC機櫃客製化需求較高，需要更多客製化零組件，也有利於鴻海提高垂直整合及零組件業務貢獻。
七、現金流及資本支出：AI擴張帶動資金需求，全年自由現金流仍待觀察
鴻海將持續透過Consignment等交易模式，降低營運資金占用。
加強應收帳款、存貨及應付帳款管理，提升現金週轉效率。
隨AI業務快速成長，高階零組件備料、存貨及應付帳款同步擴大，加上擴產需求，資本支出及資金投入也會增加。
公司強調，目前資金支出是掌握AI基礎建設商機的必要投入，背後有T1客戶明確訂單及長期需求支持。
2026年全年自由現金流能否維持正數，仍取決於第四季出貨、收款進度及資本支出實際執行情況。
資金管理將依「短支短、長支長」原則，搭配營業現金流及融資工具支應資金需求。
八、電動車投資：持續布局，但資源仍以AI為優先
鴻海將持續投入電動車領域，但相較AI業務，電動車投資占比相對較小。
目前仍觀察EV產業發展，待適當時機成熟、準備就緒後，再大規模進入市場。
與東元的合作屬於長期策略性投資，希望為集團未來發展及成長布局。
除EV外，機器人也被視為集團未來尋找第二、第三成長動能的重要方向。
九、消費電子：不評論美系客戶折疊機出貨狀況
對於美系客戶折疊機目前產量及出貨情況，劉揚偉表示，涉及特定客戶及產品，不予評論。
至於美系客戶手機今年拉貨情況，也未進一步透露。
paras_en: 1. Q3 Operations and Financial Performance
2. Q3 revenue was T$3.02 trillion, up 46% YoY and 19% QoQ; gross profit T$181.5 billion, up 39% YoY and 17% QoQ; operating profit T$115.4 billion, up 64% YoY and 22% QoQ.
3. Net income after tax was T$77.524 billion, up 34% YoY and 29% QoQ, a record single‑quarter high, with earnings per share of NT$5.51.
4. Q3 gross margin was 6.02%, operating margin 3.83% and net margin 2.57%.

5. Cumulative first‑three‑quarters revenue was T$7.66 trillion, up 39% YoY; gross profit T$467 billion, up 35% YoY; operating profit T$285.8 billion, up 65% YoY; net income T$187.417 billion, up 30% YoY; earnings per share NT$13.35.
6. First‑three‑quarters gross margin 6.10%, operating margin 3.73% and net margin 2.45%, showing continued improvement in core profitability.
7. Q4 outlook and full‑year product outlook all raised
8. Q4 AI business continues to grow, and with ICT products entering the traditional peak season, overall revenue is expected to grow strongly both QoQ and YoY.

9. Cloud and networking products: benefited by shipments of next‑generation AI server racks, AI server revenue is expected to continue QoQ growth, general servers remain modestly growing, overall cloud and networking products show significant QoQ growth and strong YoY growth.
10. Consumer smart products: entering Q4 shipment peak, demand is good, plus higher shipment prices, expected to grow strongly both QoQ and YoY.
11. Computer terminal products: affected by tight memory supply, expected QoQ decline, but some component price increases lift shipment prices, YoY growth remains significant.
12. Components and other products: benefited by increased shipments of key components related to main business, expected QoQ growth to be significant.
13. Full‑year growth target remains unchanged, as operational visibility improved since the August earnings call, all four product outlooks have been raised.
14. 2027 operating outlook remains positive, key components still face supply constraints

15. Liu Yang‑wei stated that based on current customer demand, confidence in continued growth in 2027 remains high, and this year’s performance has almost all exceeded original expectations, with trends likely to continue next year.
16. Chips, memory and some key components remain tight, a challenge shared by AI and consumer electronics industries.
17. Although new capacity is gradually coming online to ease bottlenecks, overall demand is expected to remain above supply next year, and supply‑demand tightness may persist for some time.
18. Global political and economic environment, inflation, interest rates and currency fluctuations may still affect operating costs, investment decisions and supply‑chain layout.
19. AI business drives profitability structure improvement, ROE gradually rises

20. With cloud and networking products becoming the group’s largest revenue source last year, Foxconn’s ROE has risen from below 10% during the period when consumer smart and computer terminal products dominated to over 11%.
21. First‑three‑quarters ROE this year reached 10.44%, gradually approaching the 12% annual target, and internal discussions have begun on a higher next‑stage ROE target.

22. First‑three‑quarters operating profit grew 65% YoY, higher than revenue growth of 39% and gross profit growth of 35%, showing vertical integration, automation and operational efficiency improvements continue to lift core profitability.
23. First‑three‑quarters operating margin reached 3.73%, higher than last year’s 3.2% and above the company’s 3% baseline.
24. EBITDA growth is strong, supporting capital expenditure and shareholder returns
25. 2025 EBITDA is close to T$357 billion, more than double the 2020 level.

26. First‑three‑quarters EBITDA this year reached T$369.2 billion, surpassing last year’s full‑year figure, up T$123.6 billion or 50.3%, higher than the 43% increase in capital expenditure during the same period.

27. The gap between EBITDA and capital expenditure and cash dividends continues to widen, showing improved cash‑generating ability of the core business, able to support AI‑related investment, future capital expenditure and shareholder returns.

28. Cash management follows the principle of “long‑term spend for long‑term, short‑term spend for short‑term”, using long‑term funds for long‑term investment and flexibly allocating short‑term operating needs through borrowing and cash conversion cycles.

29. The group’s debt ratio is about 64%, leaving room for future corporate bond issuance, and convertible bonds will be flexibly used as equity‑related financing tools, balancing funding cost and currency diversity.
30. QA highlights
31. 2027 operating outlook: maintain double‑digit growth, AI remains core momentum
32. Chairman Liu Yang‑wei maintains a cautiously optimistic view for 2027, expecting the group to sustain double‑digit growth.
33. IMF estimates global economic growth in 2027 at about 3.4%, higher than this year’s 3.1%, but industry still shows a K‑shaped development.

34. AI‑related industries benefit from global computing power demand and infrastructure investment, with strong growth momentum; other ICT products may be affected by tight memory supply and rising component costs.
35. Four product outlooks:

36. Cloud and networking products: the main growth driver in 2027, benefiting from CSPs continuously expanding AI capital expenditure, driving demand for AI servers and high‑speed networking equipment. Revenue share already exceeds 50% this year, expected to rise to over 60% in the next 3‑5 years.

37. Consumer smart products: main customer products are high‑end, relatively unaffected by memory shortages, and with new product development and specification upgrades, 2027 performance is expected to be relatively stable.
38. Computer products: outlook is more cautious, tight memory supply and rising component prices may push up terminal prices and affect consumer upgrade willingness.
39. Electric vehicles: overseas projects will enter mass production and delivery next year, and new vehicle models will begin commercialization, with related revenue expected to continue growing.
40. AI demand and customer pull: no sign of slowdown, long‑term policy variables still to be observed

41. Liu Yang‑wei noted that AI demand continues to rise, mainly from the four user categories: model developers, CSPs, government and enterprises, with model developers and CSPs currently the main power‑capacity demand sources.
42. From end‑user demand, CSPs and emerging cloud operators continue to expand computing capacity, and no slowdown in AI investment or customer pull has been seen yet.
43. Customers who have already placed orders and decided to build data centers may accelerate deployment in the short term.
44. U.S. midterm elections and industry changes have limited short‑term impact on AI investment, but long‑term policy and market variables remain to be observed.
45. Foxconn has a production base in the U.S.; from the front line, customer AI infrastructure deployment progress remains very active.
46. AI servers and next‑generation racks: shipments maintain double‑digit growth

47. Facing the transition to next‑generation AI server racks, Liu Yang‑wei said Foxconn has greatly reduced the common manufacturing issues through automation and vertical integration, and no obvious pain has been seen from the new product transition.
48. Q4 and 2027 AI server shipments are expected to maintain high double‑digit growth outlooks.
49. Even if revenue growth may be affected by changes in transaction models, actual rack‑level shipments are expected to remain high double‑digit growth.
50. Future monitoring of data center readiness and successful rack deployment will be key to shipment progress.
51. ASIC growth accelerates: Q3 shipments grew 1.5× YoY, next‑year momentum expected to be stronger
52. Large CSPs and model developers continue to increase in‑house chip development, and AI applications are expanding from model training to inference, driving rapid ASIC demand growth.
53. Liu Yang‑wei noted that Foxconn and major CSP customers have varying degrees of cooperation on ASIC projects.

54. ASIC customization is high, covering system architecture, motherboard, power supply, liquid‑cooling, high‑speed interconnect and rack structure, leveraging Foxconn’s vertical integration advantage.
55. Q3 Foxconn ASIC AI server shipments grew 1.5× YoY, higher than GPU AI server growth of about 70%.
56. Looking ahead to 2027, GPU and ASIC shipments will continue to grow, but ASIC will benefit from increased AI inference and AI Agent applications, potentially growing faster.
57. Research firms estimate ASIC AI server shipments will rise from 27.8% of total in 2026 to 40% in 2030.
58. Foxconn hopes that with ASIC business growth, it will not only increase system assembly but also further raise component business contribution.
59. Some ASIC projects use a consignment model, so chip costs are not included in Foxconn revenue, meaning revenue share may be lower than actual shipment share.
60. This model helps reduce operating capital usage and improve capital efficiency.
61. CPO and optical communications: bullish on the electric‑to‑optical trend, vertical integration has advantages

62. Liu Yang‑wei is optimistic about long‑term development of CPO and optical communications, believing that as large language models (LLMs) increase memory bandwidth demand and model size continues to grow, the shift from electrical to optical transmission will not change.

63. The future focus is on solving engineering and manufacturing issues, including optical fiber connectors, optoelectronic converters, and precise alignment of large numbers of fibers in small areas.
64. Foxconn has micron‑level precision machining capability, applicable to high‑precision manufacturing of optical fibers and optoelectronic components.
65. The group already has a complete product capability from cable to CPO switch, providing integrated solutions through vertical integration.
66. Foxconn holds a highly optimistic view of future growth opportunities in CPO‑related business.
67. Profitability: vertical integration of component scale expands, long‑term target of over 3% maintained
68. CFO said first‑three‑quarters operating net margin reached 3.73%, up 0.57 percentage points from last year’s 3.16%, and full‑year operating net margin is expected to exceed last year’s 3.2%.
69. Medium‑to‑long‑term operating net margin remains above 3%.

70. Facing higher AI server unit prices, component costs and product complexity, profitability will be improved through product mix optimization, economies of scale, automation and vertical integration of key components.

71. Liu Yang‑wei further revealed that the group’s vertical integration component business grew from about T$1.3 trillion last year to over T$1.6 trillion this year, with related business gross margin above 50%.
72. Increasing the proportion of in‑house component production helps lift overall average gross margin and operating profit margin.
73. ASIC and ASIC rack customization demands are high, requiring more customized components, which also benefits Foxconn’s vertical integration and component business contribution.
74. Cash flow and capital expenditure: AI expansion drives funding demand, full‑year free cash flow still to be observed
75. Foxconn will continue to use consignment and other transaction models to reduce operating capital usage.
76. Strengthen management of accounts receivable, inventory and accounts payable to improve cash‑turnover efficiency.

77. With rapid AI business growth, high‑end component inventory, inventory and accounts payable will expand, and with expansion of production capacity, capital expenditure and funding will also increase.
78. The company emphasized that current funding is a necessary investment to capture AI infrastructure opportunities, backed by T1 customer orders and long‑term demand support.
79. Whether 2026 full‑year free cash flow remains positive depends on Q4 shipments, collection progress and actual capital expenditure execution.
80. Funding management follows the “short‑term spend for short‑term, long‑term spend for long‑term” principle, coupled with operating cash flow and financing tools to meet funding needs.
81. Electric vehicle investment: continued layout, but AI remains priority
82. Foxconn will continue to invest in the EV field, but compared to AI business, EV investment share is relatively small.
83. The EV industry is still being observed; when the right timing matures and readiness is achieved, the company will enter the market at scale.
84. The partnership with Tung‑Yuan is a long‑term strategic investment, aimed at future development and growth layout for the group.
85. Besides EV, robotics is also seen as an important direction for the group to find a second or third growth driver.
86. Consumer electronics: no comment on U.S. customer foldable phone shipments
87. Regarding the current production and shipment status of U.S. customer foldable phones, Liu Yang‑wei said it involves specific customers and products and will not comment.
88. As for the U.S. customer phone order situation this year, no further disclosure was made.

items.title: 鴻海2027年AI機櫃出貨拚高雙位數成長 劉揚偉示警缺料恐延續
items.title_en: Foxconn Targets Double-Digit Growth in 2027 AI Server Cabinet Shipments, Liu Yang-Wei Warns Material Shortages May Persist
paras: 2026年11月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 鴻海(2317-TW)第三季獲利優於市場預期，董事長劉揚偉在12日法說會表示，全球雲端服務業者明年將持續增加AI資本支出，預期2027年AI伺服器機櫃出貨量可望維持高雙位數年增。不過，晶片、記憶體及關鍵零組件供應仍然吃緊，即使新增產能陸續開出，明年整體需求可能仍大於供給，缺料問題恐持續一段時間。
鴻海第三季稅後淨利達新台幣775億元，年增34%，不僅創歷年單季新高，也優於市場原先預估的696億元，超出約11.4%。第三季營收年增47%，主要受AI伺服器需求帶動。公司維持2026年全年營收強勁成長的展望，並對2027年營運持正面看法。
從產品結構來看，雲端與網通業務已成為鴻海最大的營收來源。今年相關業務占整體營收比重已超過50%，劉揚偉預期，未來三至五年將進一步提高至60%以上。這也代表鴻海的成長重心正由過去以智慧手機組裝為主，逐漸轉向AI伺服器及雲端基礎設施。
劉揚偉指出，目前尚未看到AI客戶需求出現明顯變化，全球大型雲端服務業者預期明年仍將增加AI相關資本支出。對已經決定興建AI基礎設施的客戶而言，現階段反而可能加快建置進度。鴻海除了是輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)最大的伺服器製造合作夥伴，也持續擴大美國德州與墨西哥的AI伺服器生產布局，以配合客戶需求。
不過，需求強勁也讓供應鏈面臨更大的交貨壓力。劉揚偉指出，目前晶片、記憶體及部分關鍵零組件都存在供應緊張的情況，雖然隨著新增產能開出，供應瓶頸可望逐步改善，但明年需求仍可能超過供給。換句話說，AI伺服器訂單持續增加，不代表所有設備都能按照原訂時程完成生產與交貨，零組件供應將是影響後續出貨的重要因素。
相較於AI伺服器需求強勁，劉揚偉對個人電腦（PC）市場則相對謹慎。記憶體及零組件價格上漲，可能迫使PC品牌廠提高售價，進一步影響消費者需求。智慧手機受到的衝擊則相對有限，主要是高階手機客戶具有較強的供應鏈議價能力，對成本增加的承受能力也較高。
至於外部經營環境，劉揚偉提醒，通膨、匯率及地緣政治變化，都可能影響企業營運成本與全球製造布局。美國期中選舉對AI產業的短期影響預期有限，但後續政策調整及市場變化仍須持續觀察。

paras_en: On November 12, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Foxconn (2317-TW) posted third‑quarter earnings that beat market expectations. Chairman Liu Yang‑Wei said at the press conference that global cloud service providers will continue to increase AI capital expenditures next year, and he expects AI server cabinet shipments in 2027 to maintain a high double‑digit annual growth rate. However, chip, memory and key component supplies remain tight; even as new capacity comes online, overall demand next year may still exceed supply, and material shortages could linger for some time.

Foxconn’s third‑quarter net profit after tax reached NT$77.5 billion, up 34% year‑on‑year, setting a record high for a single quarter and surpassing the market’s original estimate of NT$69.6 billion by about 11.4%. Third‑quarter revenue rose 47% year‑on‑year, driven mainly by AI server demand. The company maintains a strong outlook for full‑year 2026 revenue growth and a positive view on operations in 2027.

From a product‑mix perspective, cloud and networking businesses have become Foxconn’s largest revenue sources. This year those segments accounted for more than 50% of total revenue, and Liu expects the share to rise to over 60% in the next three to five years. This signals a shift in Foxconn’s growth focus from primarily smartphone assembly to AI servers and cloud infrastructure.

Liu noted that AI customer demand has not shown any obvious change yet, and large global cloud providers are expected to increase AI‑related capital spending next year. For customers already committed to building AI infrastructure, the current stage may actually accelerate deployment. Foxconn, besides being NVIDIA’s (NVDA‑US) largest server manufacturing partner, continues to expand its AI server production footprint in Texas, USA, and Mexico to meet client needs.

However, strong demand also puts greater delivery pressure on the supply chain. Liu pointed out that chips, memory and some key components are currently in tight supply. Although new capacity should gradually ease bottlenecks, demand next year may still outstrip supply. In other words, rising AI server orders do not guarantee that every piece of equipment can be produced and delivered on the original schedule; component supply will be a crucial factor for subsequent shipments.

Compared with the robust AI server demand, Liu is more cautious about the personal computer (PC) market. Rising memory and component prices could force PC brands to raise prices, further dampening consumer demand. The impact on smartphones is relatively limited, as high‑end phone customers have stronger bargaining power and greater ability to absorb cost increases.

Regarding the external operating environment, Liu warned that inflation, exchange‑rate fluctuations and geopolitical shifts could affect corporate operating costs and global manufacturing layouts. The U.S. mid‑term elections are expected to have limited short‑term impact on the AI industry, but subsequent policy adjustments and market changes will need ongoing monitoring.
